note: The closed vocabulary of the animations a short video's script may ask for. Renderer-neutral: no template, timing or drawing rule is here. The prose is video-presets.md.

text.note: plain text; max_items above 1 means that many texts separated by ' | '

color.note: one token of the list `palette`, never a free value

image.note: an asset slot: a description in words of the picture to show; the person uploads a PNG, JPEG or WebP for it

clip.note: an asset slot: a description in words of the clip to show; the person uploads an MP4 or MOV for it

choice.note: one value of the closed list the parameter defines

keyword.summary: one short phrase pops on screen while the person says it

list.summary: up to four short items appear one after the other

number.summary: one figure counts up with a short label under it

quote.summary: a sentence someone said, with the name of who said it

cutaway.summary: the frame shows a picture or a clip the person uploads, the speaker's face gone, while the line is spoken

pip.summary: a picture or a clip the person uploads sits in a bubble over the speaker, who stays on screen
